headline: Accenture names OpenAI a primary AI partner
summary: Rolls ChatGPT Enterprise out to tens of thousands of staff and launches a joint flagship programme to help clients scale agentic AI.

headline: Accenture and Anthropic launch multi-year partnership
summary: Creates an Accenture Anthropic Business Group; tens of thousands of Accenture developers to use Claude Code to move clients from pilots to production.

headline: Accenture agrees to acquire UK applied-AI firm Faculty
summary: Adds 400+ AI specialists and the Frontier decision-intelligence product; Faculty CEO becomes Accenture CTO. Deal closed March 2026.

headline: Accenture buys Avanseus AI tech for autonomous telecom networks
summary: Acquires prediction and anomaly-detection models to build agentic AI into its cognitive network platform for telcos.

headline: Accenture: $4.9B across 17 acquisitions in FY26
summary: FY26 revenue of $74.2B (+6%); about 110,000 AI and data professionals; signals about $5B for acquisitions in the next year.

headline: Accenture acquires UK customer-intelligence firm Sagacity
summary: Adds 140+ data and customer-intelligence specialists to Accenture Song to sell AI-led customer programmes to utilities, banks, retail and telcos.

headline: Accenture acquires construction-tech consultancy Avicado
summary: Adds 190+ specialists in construction software (Procore, Autodesk, Oracle) to Accenture Construct for capital-programme owners, including data centres.

headline: Capgemini to acquire WNS for $3.3B to lead agentic 'Intelligent Operations'
summary: All-cash deal for the India-based BPM firm; closed 17 Oct 2025. Largest AI-motivated deal in the tracked set.

headline: Capgemini closes Cloud4C acquisition
summary: Adds ~1,600 people in automation-led hybrid and sovereign cloud managed services to support GenAI cloud offerings.

headline: Capgemini: GenAI/agentic >10% of Q4 bookings
summary: Up from ~5% earlier in 2025; signed a €600M+ agentic intelligent-operations contract; plans ~€700M restructuring to re-skill.

headline: Capgemini unveils Google Cloud AI Enterprise Hub
summary: 'Outcome Deployed Engineer' pods work alongside Google's forward-deployed engineers to put Gemini agents into live operations.

headline: Capgemini agrees to sell Capgemini Government Solutions
summary: Sale of its US federal unit to ITC Federal, part of portfolio reshaping alongside AI investments.

headline: Capgemini Q3 revenue +11.7% cc; raises 2026 growth target
summary: Q3 revenue €6.07B, headcount 417,500 after WNS integration; FY26 growth guidance raised to 9.0-9.5% (about 5 pts inorganic).

headline: Cognizant completes 3Cloud acquisition (Azure)
summary: Adds ~1,200 Azure specialists, making Cognizant one of Microsoft's largest partners for cloud-native AI.

headline: Cognizant and Microsoft sign multi-year co-build, co-sell deal
summary: Embeds agentic AI and Copilot in client workflows and scales M365 Copilot and GitHub Copilot across Cognizant delivery.

headline: Cognizant partners with Cognition on autonomous software engineering
summary: Brings the Devin AI engineer into Flowsource; Cognizant says ~30% of its code is already AI-generated, targeting 50%.

headline: Cognizant to acquire AI-infrastructure specialist Astreya (~$600M)
summary: Adds AI OpsHub and hyperscale data-centre operations skills to its 'AI builder' stack.

headline: Cognizant commits to 5,000 Frontier engineers + 10,000 AI operators
summary: Platform-agnostic certified AI workforce, first cohort Q4 2026; also launched Neuro AI Trust governance platform.

headline: Cognizant reports 37% net cost saving from autonomous AI engineering
summary: First published production result of Devin-based engineering at a logistics client.

headline: Cognizant launches 'Activate' unit for emerging enterprises
summary: Pre-built AI accelerators, compressed timelines and growth-stage commercial models for high-growth companies.

headline: Cognizant forms 18,000-strong Gemini Frontier Capability Group
summary: Expands the Google Cloud alliance; builds on its Gemini practice launched April 2026.

headline: Cognizant commits 25,000+ staff to an OpenAI Frontier Capability Group
summary: Dedicated group to deliver Codex and ChatGPT for clients; 40,000+ OpenAI badges, but no client results disclosed.

headline: HCLTech signs multi-year strategic partnership with OpenAI
summary: Embeds OpenAI models in AI Force, AI Foundry and 30+ industry accelerators; deploys ChatGPT Enterprise internally. Later named OpenAI Advanced Partner.

headline: HCLTech launches AI Force 2.0 agentic platform
summary: Model-agnostic platform unifying engineering, operations and applications, with a library of agents and built-in responsible-AI checks.

headline: HCLTech reports $620M annualised 'Advanced AI' revenue for FY26
summary: Disclosed with Q4 FY26 results (revenue +12.4% YoY). Definition differs from peers, so not directly comparable.

headline: HCLTech leads Sarvam AI Series B with $150M
summary: Takes a 10%+ stake in the Indian sovereign-AI startup (valued at $1.5B post-money).

headline: HCLTech wins $1.14B AI operating-model deal
summary: New business to run the client's digital workplace and network operations with AI, Jul 2026 to Dec 2031, extendable by 5 years.

headline: HCLSoftware completes Jaspersoft acquisition
summary: Buys the BI and reporting platform from Cloud Software Group to strengthen its data and AI software portfolio.

headline: HCLTech board approves up to ₹3,500 crore for India AI data centres
summary: Wholly owned AI data centres in India targeting up to 50MW capacity.

headline: HCLTech signs 7-year AI deal and buys Guardian's India GCC
summary: Expands a January 2026 partnership; acquires Guardian India Operations (~2,000 engineers) for $10.5M and deploys AI Force.

headline: HCLSoftware to acquire RPA platform Robotiq.ai
summary: Adds enterprise RPA execution to HCL UnO Agentic orchestration; expected to close Nov 2026.

headline: Infosys and Anthropic collaborate on agentic AI for regulated industries
summary: Integrates Claude and Claude Code with Infosys Topaz; starts with an Anthropic Centre of Excellence for telecom, then BFSI and manufacturing.

headline: Infosys discloses AI services revenue at 5.5% of quarterly revenue
summary: AI-related services earned about $275M in the December 2025 quarter. (TCS had earlier cited ~$1.8B annual AI revenue, ~6%.)

headline: Infosys unveils 'AI First Value Framework' ($300B+ opportunity)
summary: Six AI service value pools (AI strategy & engineering, data for AI, process AI, agentic legacy modernisation, physical AI, AI trust) delivered on Topaz Fabric.

headline: Infosys to acquire Optimum Healthcare IT
summary: Adds a Best-in-KLAS healthcare-provider consultancy to cross-sell Topaz AI and Cobalt cloud into US health systems.

headline: Infosys to acquire P&C insurance specialist Stratus
summary: Adds 450+ Guidewire specialists with Databricks/Fabric data skills to drive AI-led claims and underwriting modernisation.

headline: Infosys expands Google Cloud tie-up for agentic AI
summary: Pairs Topaz Fabric with Gemini Enterprise for pre-packaged agent products; extends to Finacle and EdgeVerve; Gemini experience centres.

headline: Infosys and Columbia launch an Enterprise AI Center in New York
summary: Joint research centre on AI-first processes, responsible AI and AI for marketing, run with clients from Infosys's NYC office.

headline: Infosys partners with OpenAI to deploy Codex at scale
summary: Combines OpenAI models and the Codex coding agent with Topaz for legacy modernisation, code review and vulnerability detection.

headline: Infosys expands Truist deal to build its AI-first GCC in Hyderabad
summary: Infosys will build, scale and transition the US bank's global capability centre (build-operate-transfer style).

headline: TCS and AMD form strategic AI partnership
summary: Co-develop industry-specific GenAI solutions on AMD compute; framed as part of TCS's goal to be the largest AI-led services company.

headline: Tata Group, TCS and OpenAI sign multi-part AI partnership
summary: Joint industry agentic AI solutions plus a multi-year AI infrastructure deal with TCS's HyperVault unit (100MW capacity).

headline: TCS signs multi-year AI partnership with ServiceNow
summary: Builds industry solutions natively on the ServiceNow platform to turn back-office workflows (HR, finance) into agentic ones.

headline: TCS expands Google Cloud partnership with four AI offerings
summary: Embeds Gemini Enterprise across its portfolio, expands AI experience centres (7 to 10+ by end-2026); won five 2026 Google Cloud partner awards.

headline: TCS becomes first global SI partner for Mistral Forge
summary: Brings Mistral's custom-model platform to enterprises needing control over their own data, with a sovereignty angle for Europe.

headline: TCS becomes Global Premier Partner for Anthropic's Claude
summary: Sets up a dedicated Claude business unit with early model access, aimed at regulated industries (banking, healthcare, telecom).

headline: TCS annualised AI revenue reaches $3.1B (>10% of revenue)
summary: Q2 FY27 AI revenue run-rate up ~19% QoQ from $2.6B; quarter TCV $9.6B. Management says AI work carries above-average margin.

headline: TCS to take over Best Buy's India GCC as an AI Capability Centre
summary: Transitions the retailer's India global capability centre to TCS; also announced an AI Mobility CoE with Porsche in the same quarter.

headline: Tech Mahindra and Microsoft launch ontology-driven agentic AI platform
summary: Agentic platform for telecom and enterprise data-mesh modernisation; extends joint go-to-market.

headline: Tech Mahindra acquires 85% of Canada's Avant (payments)
summary: CAD 28M for 85%, rest by 2029; adds payments-modernisation and wealth-platform skills with emerging AI tools for North American banks.

headline: Tech Mahindra expands ServiceNow partnership, sets up AI CoE
summary: Multi-year deal with a 'Client Zero' model and an AI & Innovation CoE for manufacturing, telecom, BFSI and media.

headline: Tech Mahindra and CoRover.ai partner on sovereign AI
summary: Combines BharatGPT with Project Indus and TechM Orion to take India-built AI to global enterprise and government markets.

headline: Wipro to acquire HARMAN's DTS unit for up to $375M
summary: Adds 5,600+ engineers in embodied AI, embedded software and device engineering; closed 2 Dec 2025 with a Samsung/HARMAN services agreement.

headline: Wipro unveils AI-powered operating model for business operations
summary: Packages advisory, AI and process services into one consulting-led model for AI-embedded operations.

headline: Wipro creates an AI-Native Business & Platforms Unit
summary: Separate unit owns Wipro Intelligence platforms (NetOxygen, CROAMIS, WINGS, WEGA, Enterprise Telco AI) and incubates AI-led businesses.

headline: Wipro buys Olam's IT arm Mindsprint and wins $1B+ 8-year deal
summary: Acquires Olam's captive IT unit for $375M alongside an 8-year transformation contract (>$1B, $800M committed).

headline: Wipro buys Alpha Net customer contracts for up to $70.8M
summary: Contract-level acquisition of clients and staff to grow AI-led application services with low integration risk.

headline: Wipro expands ServiceNow partnership for agentic workflows
summary: Integrates Wipro Intelligence solutions (e.g. SmartProcure) with the ServiceNow AI Platform across IT, HR, procurement and security.

headline: Wipro takes stake in insurtech AI firm Aggne
summary: Reported 'buy-and-build' stake in an insurance AI engine provider (FY26 turnover ~$27.5M).

headline: Wipro expands Google Cloud deal; launches LIFT framework
summary: 10,000 AI-certified specialists incl. 1,500 forward-deployed engineers on Gemini Enterprise; LIFT links Gemini to WINGS and WEGA.
